title: Add authorized manual SEO sync with shared durable run control
summary: Prepare an admin action and persistent worker run state with database fencing; cron remains disabled.

changes.detail: Admin action with same-origin/session/rate guards and product/category edit authorization, durable status polling and server-only worker credentials.
Local-only SQL run lease with per-step fencing, expiry recovery and persisted counts/errors; legacy unfenced RPC access revoked by prepared migration.
Cron and manual invocations use the same bounded worker; no commerce changes or scheduler activation.
